title: Settings Maintenance Operator Center: Update Apply, Backup Manager, Diagnostics and Release Workflow Hardening
summary: Polishes the Settings Maintenance operator center with update apply state truthfulness, backup manager actions, explainable diagnostics and hardened release workflow behavior.
changelog: Makes Settings Maintenance update apply states truthful when failed, stalled or check_failed states are present.
Adds a unified backup manager flow for create, check, delete and clear restore-status boundaries.
Improves diagnostics and support-report actions with explainable warnings and stable operator UI.
Hardens release workflow/version convention and mobile Maintenance navigation behavior.
